items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Cecilia; the interviewer states 'I knew Cecilia, too', implying the interviewee may know her, but no direct interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Debut, right. I knew Cecilia, too, his wife at the time. She was a very nice lady, or still is, I hope.
And Eddie Byrd, remember him? He was on some of your earliest records in ’53.
